review is for the phone line process alone, not the doctors*

I'd just like to share my experience of the appointment request process this morning as it was quite disheartening, as I'm sure many have experienced getting GP appointments. I called up at 8.30am on the dot, opted for the callback service and was 11th in the queue. A few minutes later, I check back and I'm 12th in the queue, despite the service claiming it holds your space!

Then, about half an hour later I eventually get to the front, I get a call and there's just scuffling/noise for about 5 minutes. I'm just saying "hello" repeatedly and eventually the line goes clear and someone answers as if they've only just picked up the phone. The receptionist was actually friendly and understanding, no discredit to her, but all the morning appointments were gone and I was told I had to call back at 2pm for the "afternoon surgery", which is detailed nowhere on the website.

I understand that most GPs have this sort of problem, we are all collectively crying out for our taxes to be used to actually fix these important, every day problems we all face with our NHS. The systems aren't working for us, and we are a country of unwell people.

Hopefully I'll get an appointment before my issue gets worse, but for the time being I'm just frustrated, and should probably vent my concerns to higher
